CREATE VIEW v_item_economics AS
WITH r AS (
  SELECT order_item_id, SUM(returned_quantity) AS returned_quantity,
    SUM(refund_cents) AS refund_cents, SUM(recovered_cost_cents) AS recovered_cost_cents,
    SUM(handling_cost_cents) AS handling_cost_cents
  FROM returns GROUP BY order_item_id
)
SELECT i.*, o.order_date, o.customer_id, o.store_id, o.channel_id,
  i.quantity * i.unit_price_cents AS gross_sales_cents,
  i.quantity * i.unit_price_cents - i.discount_cents AS paid_sales_cents,
  COALESCE(r.returned_quantity, 0) AS returned_quantity,
  COALESCE(r.refund_cents, 0) AS refund_cents,
  COALESCE(r.recovered_cost_cents, 0) AS recovered_cost_cents,
  COALESCE(r.handling_cost_cents, 0) AS handling_cost_cents,
  i.quantity * i.unit_price_cents - i.discount_cents - COALESCE(r.refund_cents, 0) AS net_revenue_cents,
  i.quantity * i.unit_cost_cents - COALESCE(r.recovered_cost_cents, 0) AS net_cogs_cents,
  i.quantity * i.unit_price_cents - i.discount_cents - COALESCE(r.refund_cents, 0)
    - i.quantity * i.unit_cost_cents + COALESCE(r.recovered_cost_cents, 0)
    - i.commission_cents - COALESCE(r.handling_cost_cents, 0) AS item_contribution_cents
FROM order_items i JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = i.order_id
LEFT JOIN r ON r.order_item_id = i.order_item_id
WHERE o.status = 'paid'

CREATE VIEW v_order_economics AS
SELECT o.order_id, o.order_date, o.customer_id, o.store_id, o.channel_id,
  SUM(i.gross_sales_cents) AS gross_sales_cents,
  SUM(i.discount_cents) AS discount_cents,
  SUM(i.paid_sales_cents) AS paid_sales_cents,
  SUM(i.refund_cents) AS refund_cents,
  SUM(i.net_revenue_cents) AS net_revenue_cents,
  SUM(i.net_cogs_cents) AS net_cogs_cents,
  SUM(i.commission_cents) AS commission_cents,
  SUM(i.handling_cost_cents) AS handling_cost_cents,
  o.shipping_cost_cents,
  SUM(i.item_contribution_cents) - o.shipping_cost_cents AS contribution_before_ads_cents
FROM orders o JOIN v_item_economics i ON i.order_id = o.order_id
GROUP BY o.order_id, o.order_date, o.customer_id, o.store_id, o.channel_id, o.shipping_cost_cents

CREATE VIEW v_store_channel_day AS
WITH s AS (
  SELECT order_date, store_id, channel_id, COUNT(*) AS paid_orders,
    SUM(gross_sales_cents) AS gross_sales_cents, SUM(discount_cents) AS discount_cents,
    SUM(paid_sales_cents) AS paid_sales_cents, SUM(refund_cents) AS refund_cents,
    SUM(net_revenue_cents) AS net_revenue_cents,
    SUM(contribution_before_ads_cents) AS contribution_before_ads_cents
  FROM v_order_economics GROUP BY order_date, store_id, channel_id
)
SELECT m.*, COALESCE(s.paid_orders, 0) AS paid_orders,
  COALESCE(s.gross_sales_cents, 0) AS gross_sales_cents,
  COALESCE(s.discount_cents, 0) AS discount_cents,
  COALESCE(s.paid_sales_cents, 0) AS paid_sales_cents,
  COALESCE(s.refund_cents, 0) AS refund_cents,
  COALESCE(s.net_revenue_cents, 0) AS net_revenue_cents,
  COALESCE(s.contribution_before_ads_cents, 0) AS contribution_before_ads_cents,
  COALESCE(s.contribution_before_ads_cents, 0) - m.spend_cents AS contribution_after_ads_cents
FROM marketing_spend m LEFT JOIN s
  ON s.order_date = m.spend_date AND s.store_id = m.store_id AND s.channel_id = m.channel_id

  SUM(paid_orders) AS paid_orders,
  SUM(paid_sales_cents) AS paid_sales_cents,
  SUM(refund_cents) AS refund_cents,
  SUM(net_revenue_cents) AS net_revenue_cents,
  SUM(spend_cents) AS advertising_cents,
  SUM(contribution_before_ads_cents) AS contribution_before_ads_cents,
  SUM(contribution_after_ads_cents) AS contribution_after_ads_cents
FROM v_store_channel_day
WHERE spend_date BETWEEN '2026-07-01' AND '2026-08-31'
GROUP BY month ORDER BY month;

views.name: 02_lineage
views.statement:
-- Case 2: 每门店渠道仅抽取退款最多的一单，完整保留这单所有商品明细。
-- 这是可核算的来源样本，不能用它估计整个门店；汇总使用 02-stores.sql。
WITH ranked AS (
  SELECT order_id, store_id, channel_id,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY store_id, channel_id ORDER BY refund_cents DESC, order_id) AS rn
  FROM v_order_economics WHERE order_date BETWEEN '2026-08-01' AND '2026-08-31'
), r AS (
  SELECT order_item_id, SUM(refund_cents) AS refund_cents,
    group_concat(CAST(return_id AS VARCHAR), ',') AS return_ids,
    group_concat(return_date, ',') AS refund_dates,
    group_concat(reason, ',') AS return_reasons
  FROM returns GROUP BY order_item_id
)
SELECT o.channel_id, o.store_id, o.order_id, o.order_date, o.status,
  i.order_item_id, i.product_id, p.product_name, i.quantity, i.unit_price_cents, i.discount_cents,
  i.quantity*i.unit_price_cents-i.discount_cents AS paid_sales_cents,
  COALESCE(r.refund_cents,0) AS refund_cents,
  i.quantity*i.unit_price_cents-i.discount_cents-COALESCE(r.refund_cents,0) AS net_revenue_cents,
  r.return_ids, r.refund_dates, r.return_reasons
FROM ranked x JOIN orders o USING(order_id) JOIN order_items i USING(order_id)
JOIN products p USING(product_id) LEFT JOIN r USING(order_item_id)
WHERE x.rn=1 ORDER BY o.channel_id, o.store_id, o.order_id, i.order_item_id;

rules: 金额加总仅对已支付订单；取消订单有报价明细，无履约和退货，不计销售和成本。
净销售额=原价总额-折扣-退款；净商品成本=售出商品成本-可再次销售商品收回成本。
投放前经营贡献=净销售额-净商品成本-佣金-退货处理成本-正向物流；投放后再扣广告；均未扣租金、人工、税费、总部费用，不等于净利润。
经营视图以原下单日归属已知退款，历史月份会被后续退款修正；现金退款日分析直接使用 returns.return_date。本样例不是现金流量表。
退货、明细、订单、投放、目标为不同粒度事实，必须各自聚合到公共粒度后连接。不得把日广告或月目标直接连接订单明细后 SUM。
订单物流成本没有 SKU 分摊、广告没有订单/客户/SKU 归因；不提供商品投放后利润、CAC 或广告增量回报。
比率使用总分子/总分母，不平均行级比率；零分母返回 NULL，不能强填 0。
最近 30 天订单退货观察不完整；退货诊断优先选择 order_date<=2026-10-01，观察期口径仍不等于终身退货率。
复购必须使用完整 60 天观察窗口；客户数和队列指标不能跨分组直接相加。
2026 年只有 1—10 月，同比需与 2025 年 1—10 月比较；禁止直接比较全年总额。
日期、活动、折扣、渠道变化存在共同发生因素；样例可演示关联诊断，不能据此证明因果。

comparison.time_basis: 原订单日，两月均已完整观察至少 30 天退货；其他时间必须重新检查成熟度

steps.question: 真的下降了吗？是订单变少、折后支付下降，还是退款增加？
steps.required: 展示支付单数、折后支付销售额、退款、净销售额、广告支出、投放前后经营贡献；计算环比与绝对变化；用 Δ净销售额=Δ折后支付销售额-Δ退款精确对账

steps.question: 哪个渠道解释了下降？渠道是否已增加投放、是否亏损？
steps.required: 逐渠道列本期、上期、差额；渠道差额加总必须等于全站差额；负贡献渠道不得仅因销售额下降而建议加投

steps.question: 主要下降渠道内，问题集中在哪个大区、门店？
steps.required: 样例重点短视频 channel_id=4；先汇总大区再门店，对比净销售额、退款和投放后经营贡献；保留其他地区作为对照，门店合计必须与渠道一致

steps.question: 哪些品类、SKU 的退货和商品贡献发生变化？
steps.required: 大区→品类→子品类→SKU；展示售出件数、退货件数、件数退货率、退款金额率和商品贡献；按总分子/总分母计算比率，标明样本量；不能将日广告直接连到 SKU 或声称 SKU 投放后利润

steps.question: 退货原因、配送是否支持质量与履约异常的判断？
steps.required: 退款按原订单月对账，原因按质量/延迟/预期/无理由分开；准时率=到期且准时签收单数/已到期配送单数，逾期未签收计不准时；履约只按订单计数，禁止联明细后重复计数

steps.question: 能否落到原始订单和退款，并核实计算？
steps.required: 展示订单、商品明细、退货事件 ID 与计算公式；02_lineage 每门店渠道仅选一笔退款最多订单，标明是来源样本，不能作为全站归因证据

steps.question: 最终是否加大投放？
steps.required: 必须明确回答当前是扩大、维持还是暂缓预算，给出证据、优先事项与复评条件；按 decision_rules 作判断，不得停在泛泛的继续分析，也不得在新数据不满足规则时照搬样例结论。不能据历史相关性确定最优预算或宣称广告导致退款。

decision_rules: 若净销售额下降但折后支付和订单数增长，且退款增量超过支付增量，则下降直接来自退款侵蚀，不能把下降直接解释为缺流量。
若主要下降渠道广告已增加、投放后经营贡献转负且退款率明显上升，则当前不应以挽救销售为由继续扩大该链路预算；优先核查并修复质量、承诺时效和客群预期。
其他渠道历史贡献为正，不足以证明转移预算或加投有增量收益；没有实验与订单级广告归因时，不推荐确定的加投金额或增长承诺。

CREATE VIEW v_item_economics AS
WITH r AS (
  SELECT order_item_id, SUM(returned_quantity) AS returned_quantity,
    SUM(refund_cents) AS refund_cents, SUM(recovered_cost_cents) AS recovered_cost_cents,
    SUM(handling_cost_cents) AS handling_cost_cents
  FROM returns GROUP BY order_item_id
)
SELECT i.*, o.order_date, o.customer_id, o.store_id, o.channel_id,
  i.quantity * i.unit_price_cents AS gross_sales_cents,
  i.quantity * i.unit_price_cents - i.discount_cents AS paid_sales_cents,
  COALESCE(r.returned_quantity, 0) AS returned_quantity,
  COALESCE(r.refund_cents, 0) AS refund_cents,
  COALESCE(r.recovered_cost_cents, 0) AS recovered_cost_cents,
  COALESCE(r.handling_cost_cents, 0) AS handling_cost_cents,
  i.quantity * i.unit_price_cents - i.discount_cents - COALESCE(r.refund_cents, 0) AS net_revenue_cents,
  i.quantity * i.unit_cost_cents - COALESCE(r.recovered_cost_cents, 0) AS net_cogs_cents,
  i.quantity * i.unit_price_cents - i.discount_cents - COALESCE(r.refund_cents, 0)
    - i.quantity * i.unit_cost_cents + COALESCE(r.recovered_cost_cents, 0)
    - i.commission_cents - COALESCE(r.handling_cost_cents, 0) AS item_contribution_cents
FROM order_items i JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = i.order_id
LEFT JOIN r ON r.order_item_id = i.order_item_id
WHERE o.status = 'paid'

CREATE VIEW v_store_channel_day AS
WITH s AS (
  SELECT order_date, store_id, channel_id, COUNT(*) AS paid_orders,
    SUM(gross_sales_cents) AS gross_sales_cents, SUM(discount_cents) AS discount_cents,
    SUM(paid_sales_cents) AS paid_sales_cents, SUM(refund_cents) AS refund_cents,
    SUM(net_revenue_cents) AS net_revenue_cents,
    SUM(contribution_before_ads_cents) AS contribution_before_ads_cents
  FROM v_order_economics GROUP BY order_date, store_id, channel_id
)
SELECT m.*, COALESCE(s.paid_orders, 0) AS paid_orders,
  COALESCE(s.gross_sales_cents, 0) AS gross_sales_cents,
  COALESCE(s.discount_cents, 0) AS discount_cents,

  COALESCE(s.contribution_before_ads_cents, 0) - m.spend_cents AS contribution_after_ads_cents

  FROM v_order_economics WHERE order_date BETWEEN '2026-08-01' AND '2026-08-31'

    group_concat(CAST(return_id AS VARCHAR), ',') AS return_ids,
    group_concat(return_date, ',') AS refund_dates,
    group_concat(reason, ',') AS return_reasons

  i.order_item_id, i.product_id, p.product_name, i.quantity, i.unit_price_cents, i.discount_cents,

rules: 金额加总仅对已支付订单；取消订单有报价明细，无履约和退货，不计销售和成本。
净销售额=原价总额-折扣-退款；净商品成本=售出商品成本-可再次销售商品收回成本。
投放前经营贡献=净销售额-净商品成本-佣金-退货处理成本-正向物流；投放后再扣广告；均未扣租金、人工、税费、总部费用，不等于净利润。
经营视图以原下单日归属已知退款，历史月份会被后续退款修正；现金退款日分析直接使用 returns.return_date。本样例不是现金流量表。
退货、明细、订单、投放、目标为不同粒度事实，必须各自聚合到公共粒度后连接。不得把日广告或月目标直接连接订单明细后 SUM。
订单物流成本没有 SKU 分摊、广告没有订单/客户/SKU 归因；不提供商品投放后利润、CAC 或广告增量回报。
比率使用总分子/总分母，不平均行级比率；零分母返回 NULL，不能强填 0。
最近 30 天订单退货观察不完整；退货诊断优先选择 order_date<=2026-10-01，观察期口径仍不等于终身退货率。
复购必须使用完整 60 天观察窗口；客户数和队列指标不能跨分组直接相加。
2026 年只有 1—10 月，同比需与 2025 年 1—10 月比较；禁止直接比较全年总额。
日期、活动、折扣、渠道变化存在共同发生因素；样例可演示关联诊断，不能据此证明因果。

steps.question: 最终是否加大投放？
steps.required: 必须明确回答当前是扩大、维持还是暂缓预算，给出证据、优先事项与复评条件；按 decision_rules 作判断，不得停在泛泛的继续分析，也不得在新数据不满足规则时照搬样例结论。不能据历史相关性确定最优预算或宣称广告导致退款。

decision_rules: 若净销售额下降但折后支付和订单数增长，且退款增量超过支付增量，则下降直接来自退款侵蚀，不能把下降直接解释为缺流量。
若主要下降渠道广告已增加、投放后经营贡献转负且退款率明显上升，则当前不应以挽救销售为由继续扩大该链路预算；优先核查并修复质量、承诺时效和客群预期。
其他渠道历史贡献为正，不足以证明转移预算或加投有增量收益；没有实验与订单级广告归因时，不推荐确定的加投金额或增长承诺。
修复后按可比客群和区域小规模设对照，观察完整退货期后的增量投放后经营贡献；为正且履约、退货未恶化时，再讨论扩大预算。

**第一步：全站月度对比**

input.query: 从 v_store_channel_day 视图中，按月汇总 2026年7月和8月的支付订单数、折后支付销售额(paid_sales_cents)、退款(refund_cents)、净销售额(net_revenue_cents)、广告支出(spend_cents)、投放前经营贡献(contribution_before_ads_cents)、投放后经营贡献(contribution_after_ads_cents)，所有金额转为元。计算8月相对7月的环比变化量，以及净销售额变化=折后支付变化-退款变化来对账。

output.query: 从 v_store_channel_day 视图中，按月汇总 2026年7月和8月的支付订单数、折后支付销售额(paid_sales_cents)、退款(refund_cents)、净销售额(net_revenue_cents)、广告支出(spend_cents)、投放前经营贡献(contribution_before_ads_cents)、投放后经营贡献(contribution_after_ads_cents)，所有金额转为元。计算8月相对7月的环比变化量，以及净销售额变化=折后支付变化-退款变化来对账。
output.sql:
WITH monthly AS (
  SELECT 
    substr(spend_date, 1, 7) AS month,
    SUM(paid_orders) AS paid_orders,
    SUM(paid_sales_cents) / 100.0 AS paid_sales,
    SUM(refund_cents) / 100.0 AS refund,
    SUM(net_revenue_cents) / 100.0 AS net_revenue,
    SUM(spend_cents) / 100.0 AS advertising,
    SUM(contribution_before_ads_cents) / 100.0 AS contribution_before_ads,
    SUM(contribution_after_ads_cents) / 100.0 AS contribution_after_ads
  FROM v_store_channel_day
  WHERE spend_date BETWEEN '2026-07-01' AND '2026-08-31'
  GROUP BY substr(spend_date, 1, 7)
),
july AS (
  SELECT * FROM monthly WHERE month = '2026-07'
),
august AS (
  SELECT * FROM monthly WHERE month = '2026-08'
)
SELECT 
  j.paid_orders AS july_paid_orders,
  a.paid_orders AS august_paid_orders,
  a.paid_orders - j.paid_orders AS delta_paid_orders,
  j.paid_sales AS july_paid_sales,
  a.paid_sales AS august_paid_sales,
  a.paid_sales - j.paid_sales AS delta_paid_sales,
  j.refund AS july_refund,
  a.refund AS august_refund,
  a.refund - j.refund AS delta_refund,
  j.net_revenue AS july_net_revenue,
  a.net_revenue AS august_net_revenue,
  a.net_revenue - j.net_revenue AS delta_net_revenue,
  j.advertising AS july_advertising,
  a.advertising AS august_advertising,
  a.advertising - j.advertising AS delta_advertising,
  j.contribution_before_ads AS july_contribution_before_ads,
  a.contribution_before_ads AS august_contribution_before_ads,
  a.contribution_before_ads - j.contribution_before_ads AS delta_contribution_before_ads,
  j.contribution_after_ads AS july_contribution_after_ads,
  a.contribution_after_ads AS august_contribution_after_ads,
  a.contribution_after_ads - j.contribution_after_ads AS delta_contribution_after_ads,
  (a.paid_sales - j.paid_sales) - (a.refund - j.refund) AS reconcile_delta_net_revenue
FROM july j
CROSS JOIN august a;

WITH monthly AS (

    SUM(d.paid_orders) AS paid_orders,

  SUM(CASE WHEN month = '2026-08' THEN paid_orders END) AS aug_paid_orders,

  SUM(CASE WHEN month = '2026-07' THEN paid_sales END) AS jul_paid_sales,
  SUM(CASE WHEN month = '2026-08' THEN paid_sales END) AS aug_paid_sales,
  SUM(CASE WHEN month = '2026-08' THEN paid_sales END)
    - SUM(CASE WHEN month = '2026-07' THEN paid_sales END) AS diff_paid_sales,
  SUM(CASE WHEN month = '2026-07' THEN refunds END) AS jul_refunds,

  SUM(CASE WHEN month = '2026-08' THEN net_revenue END) AS aug_net_revenue,
  SUM(CASE WHEN month = '2026-08' THEN net_revenue END)
    - SUM(CASE WHEN month = '2026-07' THEN net_revenue END) AS diff_net_revenue,
  SUM(CASE WHEN month = '2026-07' THEN advertising END) AS jul_advertising,
  SUM(CASE WHEN month = '2026-08' THEN advertising END) AS aug_advertising,
  SUM(CASE WHEN month = '2026-08' THEN advertising END)
    - SUM(CASE WHEN month = '2026-07' THEN advertising END) AS diff_advertising,
  SUM(CASE WHEN month = '2026-07' THEN contribution_after_ads END) AS jul_contribution_after_ads,
  SUM(CASE WHEN month = '2026-08' THEN contribution_after_ads END) AS aug_contribution_after_ads,

**第三步：短视频商城按大区/门店拆解**

input.query: 从 v_store_channel_day 关联 stores 表，筛选 channel_id=4（短视频商城），在2026-07-01至2026-08-31区间，按月份(substr(spend_date,1,7))和大区(region)汇总 paid_orders, paid_sales_cents/100, refund_cents/100, net_revenue_cents/100, spend_cents/100, contribution_after_ads_cents/100。计算每个大区8月减7月的差值，按净销售额差值从大到小排序。

output.query: 从 v_store_channel_day 关联 stores 表，筛选 channel_id=4（短视频商城），在2026-07-01至2026-08-31区间，按月份(substr(spend_date,1,7))和大区(region)汇总 paid_orders, paid_sales_cents/100, refund_cents/100, net_revenue_cents/100, spend_cents/100, contribution_after_ads_cents/100。计算每个大区8月减7月的差值，按净销售额差值从大到小排序。
output.sql:
WITH monthly_region AS (
  SELECT 
    s.region,
    substr(d.spend_date, 1, 7) AS month,
    SUM(d.paid_orders) AS paid_orders,
    SUM(d.paid_sales_cents) / 100.0 AS paid_sales,
    SUM(d.refund_cents) / 100.0 AS refunds,
    SUM(d.net_revenue_cents) / 100.0 AS net_revenue,
    SUM(d.spend_cents) / 100.0 AS spend,
    SUM(d.contribution_after_ads_cents) / 100.0 AS contribution_after_ads
  FROM v_store_channel_day d
  JOIN stores s ON d.store_id = s.store_id
  WHERE d.channel_id = 4 
    AND d.spend_date BETWEEN '2026-07-01' AND '2026-08-31'
  GROUP BY s.region, month
)
SELECT 
  region,
  SUM(CASE WHEN month = '2026-08' THEN paid_orders ELSE 0 END) - 
  SUM(CASE WHEN month = '2026-07' THEN paid_orders ELSE 0 END) AS diff_paid_orders,
  SUM(CASE WHEN month = '2026-08' THEN paid_sales ELSE 0 END) - 
  SUM(CASE WHEN month = '2026-07' THEN paid_sales ELSE 0 END) AS diff_paid_sales,
  SUM(CASE WHEN month = '2026-08' THEN refunds ELSE 0 END) - 
  SUM(CASE WHEN month = '2026-07' THEN refunds ELSE 0 END) AS diff_refunds,
  SUM(CASE WHEN month = '2026-08' THEN net_revenue ELSE 0 END) - 
  SUM(CASE WHEN month = '2026-07' THEN net_revenue ELSE 0 END) AS diff_net_revenue,
  SUM(CASE WHEN month = '2026-08' THEN spend ELSE 0 END) - 
  SUM(CASE WHEN month = '2026-07' THEN spend ELSE 0 END) AS diff_spend,
  SUM(CASE WHEN month = '2026-08' THEN contribution_after_ads ELSE 0 END) - 
  SUM(CASE WHEN month = '2026-07' THEN contribution_after_ads ELSE 0 END) AS diff_contribution_after_ads
FROM monthly_region
GROUP BY region
ORDER BY diff_net_revenue DESC;

output.query: 从 v_store_channel_day d join stores s on d.store_id=s.store_id, 筛选 channel_id=4 and s.region='华东' and spend_date between '2026-07-01' and '2026-08-31'，按 month=substr(spend_date,1,7), s.store_id, s.store_name 分组汇总 SUM(paid_orders), SUM(refund_cents)/100, SUM(net_revenue_cents)/100, SUM(spend_cents)/100, SUM(contribution_after_ads_cents)/100。计算每个门店8月减7月的差值。

WITH monthly_stats AS (
  SELECT
    substr(d.spend_date, 1, 7) AS month,
    s.store_id,
    s.store_name,
    SUM(d.paid_orders) AS paid_orders,
    SUM(d.refund_cents) / 100.0 AS refund_amount,
    SUM(d.net_revenue_cents) / 100.0 AS net_revenue,
    SUM(d.spend_cents) / 100.0 AS ad_spend,

    AND d.spend_date BETWEEN '2026-07-01' AND '2026-08-31'
  GROUP BY month, s.store_id, s.store_name

SELECT
  store_id,
  store_name,
  SUM(CASE WHEN month = '2026-08' THEN paid_orders ELSE 0 END) -
    SUM(CASE WHEN month = '2026-07' THEN paid_orders ELSE 0 END) AS diff_paid_orders,
  SUM(CASE WHEN month = '2026-08' THEN refund_amount ELSE 0 END) -
    SUM(CASE WHEN month = '2026-07' THEN refund_amount ELSE 0 END) AS diff_refund_amount,
  SUM(CASE WHEN month = '2026-08' THEN net_revenue ELSE 0 END) -
    SUM(CASE WHEN month = '2026-07' THEN net_revenue ELSE 0 END) AS diff_net_revenue,
  SUM(CASE WHEN month = '2026-08' THEN ad_spend ELSE 0 END) -
    SUM(CASE WHEN month = '2026-07' THEN ad_spend ELSE 0 END) AS diff_ad_spend,
  SUM(CASE WHEN month = '2026-08' THEN contribution_after_ads ELSE 0 END) -
    SUM(CASE WHEN month = '2026-07' THEN contribution_after_ads ELSE 0 END) AS diff_contribution_after_ads
FROM monthly_stats
GROUP BY store_id, store_name;

events.content:
**最终结论：不建议加大投放，应先修复质量和履约问题。**

---

## 📊 诊断总结

### 全站变化桥（8月 vs 7月）

| 指标 | 7月 | 8月 | 变化 |
|------|------|------|------|
| 支付订单 | 1,533 | 1,673 | **+140** |
| 折后支付销售额 | 70.1万 | 75.2万 | **+5.15万** ✅ |
| 退款 | 3.75万 | 12.48万 | **+8.73万** ⚠️ |
| 净销售额 | 66.3万 | 62.8万 | **-3.58万** ❌ |
| 广告支出 | 2.43万 | 3.22万 | +0.79万 |
| 投放后贡献 | 17.7万 | 12.4万 | **-5.22万** ❌ |

**对账验证**：Δ净销售额 = Δ折后支付(+5.15万) - Δ退款(+8.73万) = -3.58万 ✅

**结论：折后支付和订单都在增长，净销售额下降完全来自退款侵蚀。**

### 渠道归因

| 渠道 | 净销售额变化 | 退款变化 | 投放后贡献变化 |
|------|------------|---------|--------------|
| 电商旗舰店 | +1.38万 | +0.01万 | +0.47万 ✅ |
| 线下门店 | +3.42万 | +0.62万 | +1.38万 ✅ |
| 品牌小程序 | -2.08万 | +0.26万 | -1.01万 |
| **短视频商城** | **-6.30万** | **+7.83万** | **-6.06万** ❌ |

→ **短视频商城一个渠道贡献了全站净销售额下降的176%**，且8月投放后贡献已转负（-4.57万）。

### 华东·短视频商城·下钻

| 门店 | 净销售额变化 | 退款变化 | 投放后贡献变化 |
|------|------------|---------|--------------|
| 上海体验店 | -1.31万 | +1.56万 | -1.73万 |
| 杭州体验店 | -0.51万 | +1.00万 | -1.23万 |
| 南京体验店 | -1.18万 | +0.81万 | -1.06万 |

### 根因：质量问题 + 履约崩塌

| 维度 | 7月 | 8月 |
|------|------|------|
| 厨房电器退款 | 5,719元（退货16件） | **38,525元（退货106件）** |
| 质量问题退款 | 0 | **36,461元（88次事件）** |
| 华东仓准时率 | **94%**（142/151） | **34%**（52/151） |

---

## 🚫 投放决策：暂缓加投，优先修根因

**1. 当前不能加大短视频商城投放**  
- 8月该渠道广告已增加7,933元（+44%），但投放后贡献从+1.49万转为**-4.57万**——每加1元广告亏损更多  
- 下降不是缺流量（订单+36、折后支付+1.53万），而是**退款吃了全部增量**

**2. 优先修复两大根因**  
- 🔴 **质量问题**：厨房电器出现88次质量退货，退款3.65万，需紧急排查供应链和品控  
- 🔴 **履约崩塌**：华东仓准时率从94%骤降至34%，需排查仓储产能、承运和物流调度  

**3. 修复后的复评条件**  
- 华东仓准时率恢复至85%以上  
- 厨房电器质量退货率降至正常水平  
- 按**可比客群和小区域设对照组**，观察完整退货期（≥30天）后的增量投放后经营贡献为正  
- 履约和退货未再次恶化时，**再讨论扩大预算**

> ⚡ 一句话：8月净销售额下降是退款问题，不是流量问题。在质量漏洞和履约崩溃修复前，加大投放只会放大亏损。

CREATE VIEW v_item_economics AS
WITH r AS (
  SELECT order_item_id, SUM(returned_quantity) AS returned_quantity,
    SUM(refund_cents) AS refund_cents, SUM(recovered_cost_cents) AS recovered_cost_cents,
    SUM(handling_cost_cents) AS handling_cost_cents
  FROM returns GROUP BY order_item_id
)
SELECT i.*, o.order_date, o.customer_id, o.store_id, o.channel_id,
  i.quantity * i.unit_price_cents AS gross_sales_cents,
  i.quantity * i.unit_price_cents - i.discount_cents AS paid_sales_cents,
  COALESCE(r.returned_quantity, 0) AS returned_quantity,
  COALESCE(r.refund_cents, 0) AS refund_cents,
  COALESCE(r.recovered_cost_cents, 0) AS recovered_cost_cents,
  COALESCE(r.handling_cost_cents, 0) AS handling_cost_cents,
  i.quantity * i.unit_price_cents - i.discount_cents - COALESCE(r.refund_cents, 0) AS net_revenue_cents,
  i.quantity * i.unit_cost_cents - COALESCE(r.recovered_cost_cents, 0) AS net_cogs_cents,
  i.quantity * i.unit_price_cents - i.discount_cents - COALESCE(r.refund_cents, 0)
    - i.quantity * i.unit_cost_cents + COALESCE(r.recovered_cost_cents, 0)
    - i.commission_cents - COALESCE(r.handling_cost_cents, 0) AS item_contribution_cents
FROM order_items i JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = i.order_id
LEFT JOIN r ON r.order_item_id = i.order_item_id
WHERE o.status = 'paid'

views.name: 02_lineage
views.statement:
-- Case 2: 每门店渠道仅抽取退款最多的一单，完整保留这单所有商品明细。
-- 这是可核算的来源样本，不能用它估计整个门店；汇总使用 02-stores.sql。
WITH ranked AS (
  SELECT order_id, store_id, channel_id,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY store_id, channel_id ORDER BY refund_cents DESC, order_id) AS rn
  FROM v_order_economics WHERE order_date BETWEEN '2026-08-01' AND '2026-08-31'
), r AS (
  SELECT order_item_id, SUM(refund_cents) AS refund_cents,
    group_concat(CAST(return_id AS VARCHAR), ',') AS return_ids,
    group_concat(return_date, ',') AS refund_dates,
    group_concat(reason, ',') AS return_reasons
  FROM returns GROUP BY order_item_id
)
SELECT o.channel_id, o.store_id, o.order_id, o.order_date, o.status,
  i.order_item_id, i.product_id, p.product_name, i.quantity, i.unit_price_cents, i.discount_cents,
  i.quantity*i.unit_price_cents-i.discount_cents AS paid_sales_cents,
  COALESCE(r.refund_cents,0) AS refund_cents,
  i.quantity*i.unit_price_cents-i.discount_cents-COALESCE(r.refund_cents,0) AS net_revenue_cents,
  r.return_ids, r.refund_dates, r.return_reasons
FROM ranked x JOIN orders o USING(order_id) JOIN order_items i USING(order_id)
JOIN products p USING(product_id) LEFT JOIN r USING(order_item_id)
WHERE x.rn=1 ORDER BY o.channel_id, o.store_id, o.order_id, i.order_item_id;

measures.name: sales_amount
measures.description: 净销售额=折后支付销售额-退款，按原订单日期归属

rules: 金额加总仅对已支付订单；取消订单有报价明细，无履约和退货，不计销售和成本。
净销售额=原价总额-折扣-退款；净商品成本=售出商品成本-可再次销售商品收回成本。
投放前经营贡献=净销售额-净商品成本-佣金-退货处理成本-正向物流；投放后再扣广告；均未扣租金、人工、税费、总部费用，不等于净利润。
经营视图以原下单日归属已知退款，历史月份会被后续退款修正；现金退款日分析直接使用 returns.return_date。本样例不是现金流量表。
退货、明细、订单、投放、目标为不同粒度事实，必须各自聚合到公共粒度后连接。不得把日广告或月目标直接连接订单明细后 SUM。
订单物流成本没有 SKU 分摊、广告没有订单/客户/SKU 归因；不提供商品投放后利润、CAC 或广告增量回报。
比率使用总分子/总分母，不平均行级比率；零分母返回 NULL，不能强填 0。
最近 30 天订单退货观察不完整；退货诊断优先选择 order_date<=2026-10-01，观察期口径仍不等于终身退货率。
复购必须使用完整 60 天观察窗口；客户数和队列指标不能跨分组直接相加。
2026 年只有 1—10 月，同比需与 2025 年 1—10 月比较；禁止直接比较全年总额。
日期、活动、折扣、渠道变化存在共同发生因素；样例可演示关联诊断，不能据此证明因果。

steps.question: 真的下降了吗？是订单变少、折后支付下降，还是退款增加？
steps.required: 展示支付单数、折后支付销售额、退款、净销售额、广告支出、投放前后经营贡献；计算环比与绝对变化；用 Δ净销售额=Δ折后支付销售额-Δ退款精确对账

steps.question: 哪个渠道解释了下降？渠道是否已增加投放、是否亏损？
steps.required: 逐渠道列本期、上期、差额；渠道差额加总必须等于全站差额；负贡献渠道不得仅因销售额下降而建议加投

steps.question: 主要下降渠道内，问题集中在哪个大区、门店？
steps.required: 样例重点短视频 channel_id=4；先汇总大区再门店，对比净销售额、退款和投放后经营贡献；保留其他地区作为对照，门店合计必须与渠道一致

steps.question: 哪些品类、SKU 的退货和商品贡献发生变化？
steps.required: 大区→品类→子品类→SKU；展示售出件数、退货件数、件数退货率、退款金额率和商品贡献；按总分子/总分母计算比率，标明样本量；不能将日广告直接连到 SKU 或声称 SKU 投放后利润

steps.question: 退货原因、配送是否支持质量与履约异常的判断？
steps.required: 退款按原订单月对账，原因按质量/延迟/预期/无理由分开；准时率=到期且准时签收单数/已到期配送单数，逾期未签收计不准时；履约只按订单计数，禁止联明细后重复计数

steps.question: 能否落到原始订单和退款，并核实计算？
steps.required: 展示订单、商品明细、退货事件 ID 与计算公式；02_lineage 每门店渠道仅选一笔退款最多订单，标明是来源样本，不能作为全站归因证据

steps.question: 最终是否加大投放？
steps.required: 必须明确回答当前是扩大、维持还是暂缓预算，给出证据、优先事项与复评条件；按 decision_rules 作判断，不得停在泛泛的继续分析，也不得在新数据不满足规则时照搬样例结论。不能据历史相关性确定最优预算或宣称广告导致退款。

decision_rules: 若净销售额下降但折后支付和订单数增长，且退款增量超过支付增量，则下降直接来自退款侵蚀，不能把下降直接解释为缺流量。
若主要下降渠道广告已增加、投放后经营贡献转负且退款率明显上升，则当前不应以挽救销售为由继续扩大该链路预算；优先核查并修复质量、承诺时效和客群预期。
其他渠道历史贡献为正，不足以证明转移预算或加投有增量收益；没有实验与订单级广告归因时，不推荐确定的加投金额或增长承诺。
修复后按可比客群和区域小规模设对照，观察完整退货期后的增量投放后经营贡献；为正且履约、退货未恶化时，再讨论扩大预算。

### 1. 先看计算公式和视图链条

input.query: 以 store_id=1（上海体验店）、channel_id=4（短视频商城）、2026年8月为例，从 v_item_economics 中选取退款金额最高的一笔订单，展示该订单下所有商品明细的完整计算链：order_item_id, product_id, quantity, unit_price_cents, discount_cents, gross_sales_cents = quantity * unit_price_cents, paid_sales_cents = quantity * unit_price_cents - discount_cents, refund_cents, net_revenue_cents = paid_sales_cents - refund_cents, net_cogs_cents, commission_cents, handling_cost_cents, item_contribution_cents。然后汇总到订单级别并与 v_order_economics 中同一订单的数值对比验算。

output.query: 以 store_id=1（上海体验店）、channel_id=4（短视频商城）、2026年8月为例，从 v_item_economics 中选取退款金额最高的一笔订单，展示该订单下所有商品明细的完整计算链：order_item_id, product_id, quantity, unit_price_cents, discount_cents, gross_sales_cents = quantity * unit_price_cents, paid_sales_cents = quantity * unit_price_cents - discount_cents, refund_cents, net_revenue_cents = paid_sales_cents - refund_cents, net_cogs_cents, commission_cents, handling_cost_cents, item_contribution_cents。然后汇总到订单级别并与 v_order_economics 中同一订单的数值对比验算。

WITH ranked AS (
  SELECT order_id,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(refund_cents) DESC, order_id) AS rn
  FROM v_item_economics
  WHERE store_id = 1 AND channel_id = 4
    AND order_date BETWEEN '2026-08-01' AND '2026-08-31'
  GROUP BY order_id
),
top_order AS (
  SELECT order_id FROM ranked WHERE rn = 1
),
item_details AS (
  SELECT i.order_item_id, i.product_id, i.quantity, i.unit_price_cents, i.discount_cents,
    i.quantity * i.unit_price_cents AS gross_sales_cents,
    i.quantity * i.unit_price_cents - i.discount_cents AS paid_sales_cents,
    i.refund_cents,
    i.quantity * i.unit_price_cents - i.discount_cents - i.refund_cents AS net_revenue_cents,
    i.net_cogs_cents, i.commission_cents, i.handling_cost_cents, i.item_contribution_cents
  FROM v_item_economics i
  WHERE i.order_id IN (SELECT order_id FROM top_order)
),
item_summary AS (
  SELECT 'item_detail' AS source, order_item_id AS line_id, product_id, quantity,
    unit_price_cents, discount_cents, gross_sales_cents, paid_sales_cents,
    refund_cents, net_revenue_cents, net_cogs_cents, commission_cents,
    handling_cost_cents, NULL AS shipping_cost_cents, item_contribution_cents
  FROM item_details

  UNION ALL

  SELECT 'item_sum' AS source, NULL, NULL, SUM(quantity), NULL,
    SUM(discount_cents), SUM(gross_sales_cents), SUM(paid_sales_cents),
    SUM(refund_cents), SUM(net_revenue_cents), SUM(net_cogs_cents),
    SUM(commission_cents), SUM(handling_cost_cents), NULL,
    SUM(item_contribution_cents)
  FROM item_details

  UNION ALL

  SELECT 'order_view' AS source, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL,
    o.discount_cents, o.gross_sales_cents, o.paid_sales_cents,
    o.refund_cents, o.net_revenue_cents, o.net_cogs_cents,
    o.commission_cents, o.handling_cost_cents, o.shipping_cost_cents,

下面我用这笔真实订单来完整拆解净销售额的计算逻辑和数据来源。

---

## 净销售额的计算公式

```
净销售额 = 折后支付销售额 - 退款
        = (原价总额 - 折扣) - 退款
```

按**原订单日期归属**，即客户8月下单、9月退款，退款仍算回8月。

---

## 数据从哪来：四层表 → 两层视图

### 原始表层（4张事实表）

| 表 | 粒度 | 提供什么数据 |
|---|---|---|
| **order_items** | 订单×SKU | 数量、单价、折扣、佣金 |
| **orders** | 订单 | 订单日期、渠道、门店、物流成本 |
| **returns** | 退货事件 | 退款金额、退货件数、处理成本 |
| **marketing_spend** | 日×门店×渠道 | 广告支出 |

### 视图层（两个计算视图）

**① `v_item_economics`**（商品明细级）——把退货回算到每行商品明细：

```
gross_sales  = quantity × unit_price          → 原价总额
paid_sales   = gross_sales - discount         → 折后支付销售额
net_revenue  = paid_sales - refund            → ★ 净销售额
item_contribution = net_revenue - net_cogs - commission - handling_cost
```

**② `v_order_economics`**（订单级）——在商品明细汇总基础上再扣物流成本：

```
contribution_before_ads = SUM(item_contribution) - shipping_cost
```

**③ `v_store_channel_day`**（日×门店×渠道级）——把销售和广告放在同一粒度：

```
contribution_after_ads = contribution_before_ads - advertising_spend
```

---

## 用真实订单验算

上海体验店、短视频商城、8月退款最高的一单，3行商品明细全部全额退款：

| 行 | 商品 | 数量 | 单价(分) | 折扣(分) | 折后支付(分) | 退款(分) | **净销售额(分)** |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| 34684 | #4 | 1 | 54,900 | 15,111 | 39,789 | 39,789 | **0** |
| 34685 | #31 | 1 | 16,900 | 4,604 | 12,296 | 12,296 | **0** |
| 34686 | #21 | 2 | 22,900 | 11,815 | 33,985 | 33,985 | **0** |

逐层验算：

```
原价总额   = 1×54900 + 1×16900 + 2×22900 = 117,600 (分)
折扣      = 15,111 + 4,604 + 11,815     = 31,530
折后支付   = 117,600 - 31,530            = 86,070
退款      = 39,789 + 12,296 + 33,985    = 86,070
净销售额   = 86,070 - 86,070             = 0          ✅ 全额退款→净销售额为0
```

**商品汇总 vs 订单视图对比**：

| 指标 | 商品明细汇总 | 订单视图 | 差异 |
|---|---|---|---|
| 折后支付 | 86,070 | 86,070 | 0 ✅ |
| 退款 | 86,070 | 86,070 | 0 ✅ |
| 净销售额 | 0 | 0 | 0 ✅ |
| 佣金/处理成本 | 8,607 / 4,040 | 8,607 / 4,040 | 0 ✅ |
| 商品贡献 | -44,942 | -45,869 | **-927 = 物流成本** |

差额 927 分恰好等于订单的 `shipping_cost_cents`，因为订单级贡献 = 商品贡献汇总 - 物流成本——逻辑严丝合缝。

---

## 一句话总结

> **净销售额 = 原价总额 − 折扣 − 退款**，数据从 `order_items` 拿单价/数量/折扣，从 `returns` 拿退款，在 `v_item_economics` 视图中按原订单日回算到每行商品明细。汇总后经过 `v_order_economics`（扣物流）、`v_store_channel_day`（扣广告）逐层聚合——每一层都可以下钻到原始订单和退货事件逐笔核实。

CREATE VIEW v_item_economics AS
WITH r AS (
  SELECT order_item_id, SUM(returned_quantity) AS returned_quantity,
    SUM(refund_cents) AS refund_cents, SUM(recovered_cost_cents) AS recovered_cost_cents,
    SUM(handling_cost_cents) AS handling_cost_cents
  FROM returns GROUP BY order_item_id
)
SELECT i.*, o.order_date, o.customer_id, o.store_id, o.channel_id,
  i.quantity * i.unit_price_cents AS gross_sales_cents,
  i.quantity * i.unit_price_cents - i.discount_cents AS paid_sales_cents,
  COALESCE(r.returned_quantity, 0) AS returned_quantity,
  COALESCE(r.refund_cents, 0) AS refund_cents,
  COALESCE(r.recovered_cost_cents, 0) AS recovered_cost_cents,
  COALESCE(r.handling_cost_cents, 0) AS handling_cost_cents,
  i.quantity * i.unit_price_cents - i.discount_cents - COALESCE(r.refund_cents, 0) AS net_revenue_cents,
  i.quantity * i.unit_cost_cents - COALESCE(r.recovered_cost_cents, 0) AS net_cogs_cents,
  i.quantity * i.unit_price_cents - i.discount_cents - COALESCE(r.refund_cents, 0)
    - i.quantity * i.unit_cost_cents + COALESCE(r.recovered_cost_cents, 0)
    - i.commission_cents - COALESCE(r.handling_cost_cents, 0) AS item_contribution_cents
FROM order_items i JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = i.order_id
LEFT JOIN r ON r.order_item_id = i.order_item_id
WHERE o.status = 'paid'

CREATE VIEW v_order_economics AS
SELECT o.order_id, o.order_date, o.customer_id, o.store_id, o.channel_id,
  SUM(i.gross_sales_cents) AS gross_sales_cents,
  SUM(i.discount_cents) AS discount_cents,
  SUM(i.paid_sales_cents) AS paid_sales_cents,
  SUM(i.refund_cents) AS refund_cents,
  SUM(i.net_revenue_cents) AS net_revenue_cents,
  SUM(i.net_cogs_cents) AS net_cogs_cents,
  SUM(i.commission_cents) AS commission_cents,
  SUM(i.handling_cost_cents) AS handling_cost_cents,
  o.shipping_cost_cents,
  SUM(i.item_contribution_cents) - o.shipping_cost_cents AS contribution_before_ads_cents
FROM orders o JOIN v_item_economics i ON i.order_id = o.order_id
GROUP BY o.order_id, o.order_date, o.customer_id, o.store_id, o.channel_id, o.shipping_cost_cents

CREATE VIEW v_store_channel_day AS
WITH s AS (
  SELECT order_date, store_id, channel_id, COUNT(*) AS paid_orders,
    SUM(gross_sales_cents) AS gross_sales_cents, SUM(discount_cents) AS discount_cents,
    SUM(paid_sales_cents) AS paid_sales_cents, SUM(refund_cents) AS refund_cents,
    SUM(net_revenue_cents) AS net_revenue_cents,
    SUM(contribution_before_ads_cents) AS contribution_before_ads_cents
  FROM v_order_economics GROUP BY order_date, store_id, channel_id
)
SELECT m.*, COALESCE(s.paid_orders, 0) AS paid_orders,
  COALESCE(s.gross_sales_cents, 0) AS gross_sales_cents,
  COALESCE(s.discount_cents, 0) AS discount_cents,
  COALESCE(s.paid_sales_cents, 0) AS paid_sales_cents,
  COALESCE(s.refund_cents, 0) AS refund_cents,
  COALESCE(s.net_revenue_cents, 0) AS net_revenue_cents,
  COALESCE(s.contribution_before_ads_cents, 0) AS contribution_before_ads_cents,
  COALESCE(s.contribution_before_ads_cents, 0) - m.spend_cents AS contribution_after_ads_cents
FROM marketing_spend m LEFT JOIN s
  ON s.order_date = m.spend_date AND s.store_id = m.store_id AND s.channel_id = m.channel_id

rules: 金额加总仅对已支付订单；取消订单有报价明细，无履约和退货，不计销售和成本。
净销售额=原价总额-折扣-退款；净商品成本=售出商品成本-可再次销售商品收回成本。
投放前经营贡献=净销售额-净商品成本-佣金-退货处理成本-正向物流；投放后再扣广告；均未扣租金、人工、税费、总部费用，不等于净利润。
经营视图以原下单日归属已知退款，历史月份会被后续退款修正；现金退款日分析直接使用 returns.return_date。本样例不是现金流量表。
退货、明细、订单、投放、目标为不同粒度事实，必须各自聚合到公共粒度后连接。不得把日广告或月目标直接连接订单明细后 SUM。
订单物流成本没有 SKU 分摊、广告没有订单/客户/SKU 归因；不提供商品投放后利润、CAC 或广告增量回报。
比率使用总分子/总分母，不平均行级比率；零分母返回 NULL，不能强填 0。
最近 30 天订单退货观察不完整；退货诊断优先选择 order_date<=2026-10-01，观察期口径仍不等于终身退货率。
复购必须使用完整 60 天观察窗口；客户数和队列指标不能跨分组直接相加。
2026 年只有 1—10 月，同比需与 2025 年 1—10 月比较；禁止直接比较全年总额。
日期、活动、折扣、渠道变化存在共同发生因素；样例可演示关联诊断，不能据此证明因果。

steps.question: 真的下降了吗？是订单变少、折后支付下降，还是退款增加？
steps.required: 展示支付单数、折后支付销售额、退款、净销售额、广告支出、投放前后经营贡献；计算环比与绝对变化；用 Δ净销售额=Δ折后支付销售额-Δ退款精确对账

steps.required: 逐渠道列本期、上期、差额；渠道差额加总必须等于全站差额；负贡献渠道不得仅因销售额下降而建议加投

steps.question: 主要下降渠道内，问题集中在哪个大区、门店？
steps.required: 样例重点短视频 channel_id=4；先汇总大区再门店，对比净销售额、退款和投放后经营贡献；保留其他地区作为对照，门店合计必须与渠道一致

steps.question: 哪些品类、SKU 的退货和商品贡献发生变化？
steps.required: 大区→品类→子品类→SKU；展示售出件数、退货件数、件数退货率、退款金额率和商品贡献；按总分子/总分母计算比率，标明样本量；不能将日广告直接连到 SKU 或声称 SKU 投放后利润

steps.question: 退货原因、配送是否支持质量与履约异常的判断？

decision_rules: 若净销售额下降但折后支付和订单数增长，且退款增量超过支付增量，则下降直接来自退款侵蚀，不能把下降直接解释为缺流量。

修复后按可比客群和区域小规模设对照，观察完整退货期后的增量投放后经营贡献；为正且履约、退货未恶化时，再讨论扩大预算。

properties.sql_definition:
CREATE VIEW v_item_economics AS
WITH r AS (
  SELECT order_item_id, SUM(returned_quantity) AS returned_quantity,
    SUM(refund_cents) AS refund_cents, SUM(recovered_cost_cents) AS recovered_cost_cents,
    SUM(handling_cost_cents) AS handling_cost_cents
  FROM returns GROUP BY order_item_id
)
SELECT i.*, o.order_date, o.customer_id, o.store_id, o.channel_id,
  i.quantity * i.unit_price_cents AS gross_sales_cents,
  i.quantity * i.unit_price_cents - i.discount_cents AS paid_sales_cents,
  COALESCE(r.returned_quantity, 0) AS returned_quantity,
  COALESCE(r.refund_cents, 0) AS refund_cents,
  COALESCE(r.recovered_cost_cents, 0) AS recovered_cost_cents,
  COALESCE(r.handling_cost_cents, 0) AS handling_cost_cents,
  i.quantity * i.unit_price_cents - i.discount_cents - COALESCE(r.refund_cents, 0) AS net_revenue_cents,
  i.quantity * i.unit_cost_cents - COALESCE(r.recovered_cost_cents, 0) AS net_cogs_cents,
  i.quantity * i.unit_price_cents - i.discount_cents - COALESCE(r.refund_cents, 0)
    - i.quantity * i.unit_cost_cents + COALESCE(r.recovered_cost_cents, 0)
    - i.commission_cents - COALESCE(r.handling_cost_cents, 0) AS item_contribution_cents
FROM order_items i JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = i.order_id
LEFT JOIN r ON r.order_item_id = i.order_item_id
WHERE o.status = 'paid'

CREATE VIEW v_order_economics AS
SELECT o.order_id, o.order_date, o.customer_id, o.store_id, o.channel_id,
  SUM(i.gross_sales_cents) AS gross_sales_cents,
  SUM(i.discount_cents) AS discount_cents,
  SUM(i.paid_sales_cents) AS paid_sales_cents,
  SUM(i.refund_cents) AS refund_cents,
  SUM(i.net_revenue_cents) AS net_revenue_cents,
  SUM(i.net_cogs_cents) AS net_cogs_cents,
  SUM(i.commission_cents) AS commission_cents,
  SUM(i.handling_cost_cents) AS handling_cost_cents,
  o.shipping_cost_cents,
  SUM(i.item_contribution_cents) - o.shipping_cost_cents AS contribution_before_ads_cents
FROM orders o JOIN v_item_economics i ON i.order_id = o.order_id
GROUP BY o.order_id, o.order_date, o.customer_id, o.store_id, o.channel_id, o.shipping_cost_cents

CREATE VIEW v_store_channel_day AS
WITH s AS (
  SELECT order_date, store_id, channel_id, COUNT(*) AS paid_orders,
    SUM(gross_sales_cents) AS gross_sales_cents, SUM(discount_cents) AS discount_cents,
    SUM(paid_sales_cents) AS paid_sales_cents, SUM(refund_cents) AS refund_cents,
    SUM(net_revenue_cents) AS net_revenue_cents,
    SUM(contribution_before_ads_cents) AS contribution_before_ads_cents
  FROM v_order_economics GROUP BY order_date, store_id, channel_id
)
SELECT m.*, COALESCE(s.paid_orders, 0) AS paid_orders,
  COALESCE(s.gross_sales_cents, 0) AS gross_sales_cents,
  COALESCE(s.discount_cents, 0) AS discount_cents,
  COALESCE(s.paid_sales_cents, 0) AS paid_sales_cents,
  COALESCE(s.refund_cents, 0) AS refund_cents,
  COALESCE(s.net_revenue_cents, 0) AS net_revenue_cents,
  COALESCE(s.contribution_before_ads_cents, 0) AS contribution_before_ads_cents,
  COALESCE(s.contribution_before_ads_cents, 0) - m.spend_cents AS contribution_after_ads_cents
FROM marketing_spend m LEFT JOIN s
  ON s.order_date = m.spend_date AND s.store_id = m.store_id AND s.channel_id = m.channel_id

views.name: 02_lineage
views.statement:
-- Case 2: 每门店渠道仅抽取退款最多的一单，完整保留这单所有商品明细。
-- 这是可核算的来源样本，不能用它估计整个门店；汇总使用 02-stores.sql。
WITH ranked AS (
  SELECT order_id, store_id, channel_id,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY store_id, channel_id ORDER BY refund_cents DESC, order_id) AS rn
  FROM v_order_economics WHERE order_date BETWEEN '2026-08-01' AND '2026-08-31'
), r AS (
  SELECT order_item_id, SUM(refund_cents) AS refund_cents,
    group_concat(CAST(return_id AS VARCHAR), ',') AS return_ids,
    group_concat(return_date, ',') AS refund_dates,
    group_concat(reason, ',') AS return_reasons
  FROM returns GROUP BY order_item_id
)
SELECT o.channel_id, o.store_id, o.order_id, o.order_date, o.status,
  i.order_item_id, i.product_id, p.product_name, i.quantity, i.unit_price_cents, i.discount_cents,
  i.quantity*i.unit_price_cents-i.discount_cents AS paid_sales_cents,
  COALESCE(r.refund_cents,0) AS refund_cents,
  i.quantity*i.unit_price_cents-i.discount_cents-COALESCE(r.refund_cents,0) AS net_revenue_cents,
  r.return_ids, r.refund_dates, r.return_reasons
FROM ranked x JOIN orders o USING(order_id) JOIN order_items i USING(order_id)
JOIN products p USING(product_id) LEFT JOIN r USING(order_item_id)
WHERE x.rn=1 ORDER BY o.channel_id, o.store_id, o.order_id, i.order_item_id;

rules: 金额加总仅对已支付订单；取消订单有报价明细，无履约和退货，不计销售和成本。
净销售额=原价总额-折扣-退款；净商品成本=售出商品成本-可再次销售商品收回成本。
投放前经营贡献=净销售额-净商品成本-佣金-退货处理成本-正向物流；投放后再扣广告；均未扣租金、人工、税费、总部费用，不等于净利润。
经营视图以原下单日归属已知退款，历史月份会被后续退款修正；现金退款日分析直接使用 returns.return_date。本样例不是现金流量表。
退货、明细、订单、投放、目标为不同粒度事实，必须各自聚合到公共粒度后连接。不得把日广告或月目标直接连接订单明细后 SUM。
订单物流成本没有 SKU 分摊、广告没有订单/客户/SKU 归因；不提供商品投放后利润、CAC 或广告增量回报。
比率使用总分子/总分母，不平均行级比率；零分母返回 NULL，不能强填 0。
最近 30 天订单退货观察不完整；退货诊断优先选择 order_date<=2026-10-01，观察期口径仍不等于终身退货率。
复购必须使用完整 60 天观察窗口；客户数和队列指标不能跨分组直接相加。
2026 年只有 1—10 月，同比需与 2025 年 1—10 月比较；禁止直接比较全年总额。
日期、活动、折扣、渠道变化存在共同发生因素；样例可演示关联诊断，不能据此证明因果。

steps.required: 展示支付单数、折后支付销售额、退款、净销售额、广告支出、投放前后经营贡献；计算环比与绝对变化；用 Δ净销售额=Δ折后支付销售额-Δ退款精确对账

steps.question: 哪个渠道解释了下降？渠道是否已增加投放、是否亏损？
steps.required: 逐渠道列本期、上期、差额；渠道差额加总必须等于全站差额；负贡献渠道不得仅因销售额下降而建议加投

steps.question: 主要下降渠道内，问题集中在哪个大区、门店？
steps.required: 样例重点短视频 channel_id=4；先汇总大区再门店，对比净销售额、退款和投放后经营贡献；保留其他地区作为对照，门店合计必须与渠道一致

steps.question: 哪些品类、SKU 的退货和商品贡献发生变化？
steps.required: 大区→品类→子品类→SKU；展示售出件数、退货件数、件数退货率、退款金额率和商品贡献；按总分子/总分母计算比率，标明样本量；不能将日广告直接连到 SKU 或声称 SKU 投放后利润

steps.question: 退货原因、配送是否支持质量与履约异常的判断？
steps.required: 退款按原订单月对账，原因按质量/延迟/预期/无理由分开；准时率=到期且准时签收单数/已到期配送单数，逾期未签收计不准时；履约只按订单计数，禁止联明细后重复计数

steps.question: 能否落到原始订单和退款，并核实计算？
steps.required: 展示订单、商品明细、退货事件 ID 与计算公式；02_lineage 每门店渠道仅选一笔退款最多订单，标明是来源样本，不能作为全站归因证据

steps.question: 最终是否加大投放？
steps.required: 必须明确回答当前是扩大、维持还是暂缓预算，给出证据、优先事项与复评条件；按 decision_rules 作判断，不得停在泛泛的继续分析，也不得在新数据不满足规则时照搬样例结论。不能据历史相关性确定最优预算或宣称广告导致退款。

decision_rules: 若净销售额下降但折后支付和订单数增长，且退款增量超过支付增量，则下降直接来自退款侵蚀，不能把下降直接解释为缺流量。
若主要下降渠道广告已增加、投放后经营贡献转负且退款率明显上升，则当前不应以挽救销售为由继续扩大该链路预算；优先核查并修复质量、承诺时效和客群预期。
其他渠道历史贡献为正，不足以证明转移预算或加投有增量收益；没有实验与订单级广告归因时，不推荐确定的加投金额或增长承诺。
修复后按可比客群和区域小规模设对照，观察完整退货期后的增量投放后经营贡献；为正且履约、退货未恶化时，再讨论扩大预算。

CREATE VIEW v_item_economics AS
WITH r AS (
  SELECT order_item_id, SUM(returned_quantity) AS returned_quantity,
    SUM(refund_cents) AS refund_cents, SUM(recovered_cost_cents) AS recovered_cost_cents,
    SUM(handling_cost_cents) AS handling_cost_cents
  FROM returns GROUP BY order_item_id
)
SELECT i.*, o.order_date, o.customer_id, o.store_id, o.channel_id,
  i.quantity * i.unit_price_cents AS gross_sales_cents,
  i.quantity * i.unit_price_cents - i.discount_cents AS paid_sales_cents,
  COALESCE(r.returned_quantity, 0) AS returned_quantity,
  COALESCE(r.refund_cents, 0) AS refund_cents,
  COALESCE(r.recovered_cost_cents, 0) AS recovered_cost_cents,
  COALESCE(r.handling_cost_cents, 0) AS handling_cost_cents,
  i.quantity * i.unit_price_cents - i.discount_cents - COALESCE(r.refund_cents, 0) AS net_revenue_cents,
  i.quantity * i.unit_cost_cents - COALESCE(r.recovered_cost_cents, 0) AS net_cogs_cents,
  i.quantity * i.unit_price_cents - i.discount_cents - COALESCE(r.refund_cents, 0)
    - i.quantity * i.unit_cost_cents + COALESCE(r.recovered_cost_cents, 0)
    - i.commission_cents - COALESCE(r.handling_cost_cents, 0) AS item_contribution_cents
FROM order_items i JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = i.order_id
LEFT JOIN r ON r.order_item_id = i.order_item_id
WHERE o.status = 'paid'

CREATE VIEW v_order_economics AS
SELECT o.order_id, o.order_date, o.customer_id, o.store_id, o.channel_id,
  SUM(i.gross_sales_cents) AS gross_sales_cents,
  SUM(i.discount_cents) AS discount_cents,
  SUM(i.paid_sales_cents) AS paid_sales_cents,
  SUM(i.refund_cents) AS refund_cents,
  SUM(i.net_revenue_cents) AS net_revenue_cents,
  SUM(i.net_cogs_cents) AS net_cogs_cents,
  SUM(i.commission_cents) AS commission_cents,
  SUM(i.handling_cost_cents) AS handling_cost_cents,
  o.shipping_cost_cents,
  SUM(i.item_contribution_cents) - o.shipping_cost_cents AS contribution_before_ads_cents
FROM orders o JOIN v_item_economics i ON i.order_id = o.order_id
GROUP BY o.order_id, o.order_date, o.customer_id, o.store_id, o.channel_id, o.shipping_cost_cents

CREATE VIEW v_store_channel_day AS
WITH s AS (
  SELECT order_date, store_id, channel_id, COUNT(*) AS paid_orders,
    SUM(gross_sales_cents) AS gross_sales_cents, SUM(discount_cents) AS discount_cents,
    SUM(paid_sales_cents) AS paid_sales_cents, SUM(refund_cents) AS refund_cents,
    SUM(net_revenue_cents) AS net_revenue_cents,
    SUM(contribution_before_ads_cents) AS contribution_before_ads_cents
  FROM v_order_economics GROUP BY order_date, store_id, channel_id
)
SELECT m.*, COALESCE(s.paid_orders, 0) AS paid_orders,
  COALESCE(s.gross_sales_cents, 0) AS gross_sales_cents,
  COALESCE(s.discount_cents, 0) AS discount_cents,
  COALESCE(s.paid_sales_cents, 0) AS paid_sales_cents,
  COALESCE(s.refund_cents, 0) AS refund_cents,
  COALESCE(s.net_revenue_cents, 0) AS net_revenue_cents,
  COALESCE(s.contribution_before_ads_cents, 0) AS contribution_before_ads_cents,
  COALESCE(s.contribution_before_ads_cents, 0) - m.spend_cents AS contribution_after_ads_cents
FROM marketing_spend m LEFT JOIN s
  ON s.order_date = m.spend_date AND s.store_id = m.store_id AND s.channel_id = m.channel_id

-- Case 2: 每门店渠道仅抽取退款最多的一单，完整保留这单所有商品明细。
-- 这是可核算的来源样本，不能用它估计整个门店；汇总使用 02-stores.sql。
WITH ranked AS (
  SELECT order_id, store_id, channel_id,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY store_id, channel_id ORDER BY refund_cents DESC, order_id) AS rn
  FROM v_order_economics WHERE order_date BETWEEN '2026-08-01' AND '2026-08-31'
), r AS (
  SELECT order_item_id, SUM(refund_cents) AS refund_cents,
    group_concat(CAST(return_id AS VARCHAR), ',') AS return_ids,
    group_concat(return_date, ',') AS refund_dates,
    group_concat(reason, ',') AS return_reasons
  FROM returns GROUP BY order_item_id
)
SELECT o.channel_id, o.store_id, o.order_id, o.order_date, o.status,
  i.order_item_id, i.product_id, p.product_name, i.quantity, i.unit_price_cents, i.discount_cents,
  i.quantity*i.unit_price_cents-i.discount_cents AS paid_sales_cents,
  COALESCE(r.refund_cents,0) AS refund_cents,
  i.quantity*i.unit_price_cents-i.discount_cents-COALESCE(r.refund_cents,0) AS net_revenue_cents,
  r.return_ids, r.refund_dates, r.return_reasons
FROM ranked x JOIN orders o USING(order_id) JOIN order_items i USING(order_id)
JOIN products p USING(product_id) LEFT JOIN r USING(order_item_id)
WHERE x.rn=1 ORDER BY o.channel_id, o.store_id, o.order_id, i.order_item_id;

rules: 金额加总仅对已支付订单；取消订单有报价明细，无履约和退货，不计销售和成本。
净销售额=原价总额-折扣-退款；净商品成本=售出商品成本-可再次销售商品收回成本。
投放前经营贡献=净销售额-净商品成本-佣金-退货处理成本-正向物流；投放后再扣广告；均未扣租金、人工、税费、总部费用，不等于净利润。
经营视图以原下单日归属已知退款，历史月份会被后续退款修正；现金退款日分析直接使用 returns.return_date。本样例不是现金流量表。
退货、明细、订单、投放、目标为不同粒度事实，必须各自聚合到公共粒度后连接。不得把日广告或月目标直接连接订单明细后 SUM。
订单物流成本没有 SKU 分摊、广告没有订单/客户/SKU 归因；不提供商品投放后利润、CAC 或广告增量回报。
比率使用总分子/总分母，不平均行级比率；零分母返回 NULL，不能强填 0。
最近 30 天订单退货观察不完整；退货诊断优先选择 order_date<=2026-10-01，观察期口径仍不等于终身退货率。
复购必须使用完整 60 天观察窗口；客户数和队列指标不能跨分组直接相加。
2026 年只有 1—10 月，同比需与 2025 年 1—10 月比较；禁止直接比较全年总额。
日期、活动、折扣、渠道变化存在共同发生因素；样例可演示关联诊断，不能据此证明因果。

steps.question: 真的下降了吗？是订单变少、折后支付下降，还是退款增加？
steps.required: 展示支付单数、折后支付销售额、退款、净销售额、广告支出、投放前后经营贡献；计算环比与绝对变化；用 Δ净销售额=Δ折后支付销售额-Δ退款精确对账

steps.question: 哪个渠道解释了下降？渠道是否已增加投放、是否亏损？
steps.required: 逐渠道列本期、上期、差额；渠道差额加总必须等于全站差额；负贡献渠道不得仅因销售额下降而建议加投

steps.question: 主要下降渠道内，问题集中在哪个大区、门店？
steps.required: 样例重点短视频 channel_id=4；先汇总大区再门店，对比净销售额、退款和投放后经营贡献；保留其他地区作为对照，门店合计必须与渠道一致

steps.question: 哪些品类、SKU 的退货和商品贡献发生变化？
steps.required: 大区→品类→子品类→SKU；展示售出件数、退货件数、件数退货率、退款金额率和商品贡献；按总分子/总分母计算比率，标明样本量；不能将日广告直接连到 SKU 或声称 SKU 投放后利润

steps.question: 退货原因、配送是否支持质量与履约异常的判断？
steps.required: 退款按原订单月对账，原因按质量/延迟/预期/无理由分开；准时率=到期且准时签收单数/已到期配送单数，逾期未签收计不准时；履约只按订单计数，禁止联明细后重复计数

steps.question: 能否落到原始订单和退款，并核实计算？
steps.required: 展示订单、商品明细、退货事件 ID 与计算公式；02_lineage 每门店渠道仅选一笔退款最多订单，标明是来源样本，不能作为全站归因证据

steps.question: 最终是否加大投放？
steps.required: 必须明确回答当前是扩大、维持还是暂缓预算，给出证据、优先事项与复评条件；按 decision_rules 作判断，不得停在泛泛的继续分析，也不得在新数据不满足规则时照搬样例结论。不能据历史相关性确定最优预算或宣称广告导致退款。

decision_rules: 若净销售额下降但折后支付和订单数增长，且退款增量超过支付增量，则下降直接来自退款侵蚀，不能把下降直接解释为缺流量。
若主要下降渠道广告已增加、投放后经营贡献转负且退款率明显上升，则当前不应以挽救销售为由继续扩大该链路预算；优先核查并修复质量、承诺时效和客群预期。
其他渠道历史贡献为正，不足以证明转移预算或加投有增量收益；没有实验与订单级广告归因时，不推荐确定的加投金额或增长承诺。
修复后按可比客群和区域小规模设对照，观察完整退货期后的增量投放后经营贡献；为正且履约、退货未恶化时，再讨论扩大预算。

CREATE VIEW v_item_economics AS
WITH r AS (
  SELECT order_item_id, SUM(returned_quantity) AS returned_quantity,
    SUM(refund_cents) AS refund_cents, SUM(recovered_cost_cents) AS recovered_cost_cents,
    SUM(handling_cost_cents) AS handling_cost_cents
  FROM returns GROUP BY order_item_id
)
SELECT i.*, o.order_date, o.customer_id, o.store_id, o.channel_id,
  i.quantity * i.unit_price_cents AS gross_sales_cents,
  i.quantity * i.unit_price_cents - i.discount_cents AS paid_sales_cents,
  COALESCE(r.returned_quantity, 0) AS returned_quantity,
  COALESCE(r.refund_cents, 0) AS refund_cents,
  COALESCE(r.recovered_cost_cents, 0) AS recovered_cost_cents,
  COALESCE(r.handling_cost_cents, 0) AS handling_cost_cents,
  i.quantity * i.unit_price_cents - i.discount_cents - COALESCE(r.refund_cents, 0) AS net_revenue_cents,
  i.quantity * i.unit_cost_cents - COALESCE(r.recovered_cost_cents, 0) AS net_cogs_cents,
  i.quantity * i.unit_price_cents - i.discount_cents - COALESCE(r.refund_cents, 0)
    - i.quantity * i.unit_cost_cents + COALESCE(r.recovered_cost_cents, 0)
    - i.commission_cents - COALESCE(r.handling_cost_cents, 0) AS item_contribution_cents
FROM order_items i JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = i.order_id
LEFT JOIN r ON r.order_item_id = i.order_item_id
WHERE o.status = 'paid'

CREATE VIEW v_order_economics AS
SELECT o.order_id, o.order_date, o.customer_id, o.store_id, o.channel_id,
  SUM(i.gross_sales_cents) AS gross_sales_cents,
  SUM(i.discount_cents) AS discount_cents,
  SUM(i.paid_sales_cents) AS paid_sales_cents,
  SUM(i.refund_cents) AS refund_cents,
  SUM(i.net_revenue_cents) AS net_revenue_cents,
  SUM(i.net_cogs_cents) AS net_cogs_cents,
  SUM(i.commission_cents) AS commission_cents,
  SUM(i.handling_cost_cents) AS handling_cost_cents,
  o.shipping_cost_cents,
  SUM(i.item_contribution_cents) - o.shipping_cost_cents AS contribution_before_ads_cents
FROM orders o JOIN v_item_economics i ON i.order_id = o.order_id
GROUP BY o.order_id, o.order_date, o.customer_id, o.store_id, o.channel_id, o.shipping_cost_cents

CREATE VIEW v_store_channel_day AS
WITH s AS (
  SELECT order_date, store_id, channel_id, COUNT(*) AS paid_orders,
    SUM(gross_sales_cents) AS gross_sales_cents, SUM(discount_cents) AS discount_cents,
    SUM(paid_sales_cents) AS paid_sales_cents, SUM(refund_cents) AS refund_cents,
    SUM(net_revenue_cents) AS net_revenue_cents,
    SUM(contribution_before_ads_cents) AS contribution_before_ads_cents
  FROM v_order_economics GROUP BY order_date, store_id, channel_id
)
SELECT m.*, COALESCE(s.paid_orders, 0) AS paid_orders,
  COALESCE(s.gross_sales_cents, 0) AS gross_sales_cents,
  COALESCE(s.discount_cents, 0) AS discount_cents,
  COALESCE(s.paid_sales_cents, 0) AS paid_sales_cents,
  COALESCE(s.refund_cents, 0) AS refund_cents,
  COALESCE(s.net_revenue_cents, 0) AS net_revenue_cents,
  COALESCE(s.contribution_before_ads_cents, 0) AS contribution_before_ads_cents,
  COALESCE(s.contribution_before_ads_cents, 0) - m.spend_cents AS contribution_after_ads_cents
FROM marketing_spend m LEFT JOIN s
  ON s.order_date = m.spend_date AND s.store_id = m.store_id AND s.channel_id = m.channel_id

  i.order_item_id, i.product_id, p.product_name, i.quantity, i.unit_price_cents, i.discount_cents,
  i.quantity*i.unit_price_cents-i.discount_cents AS paid_sales_cents,
  COALESCE(r.refund_cents,0) AS refund_cents,
  i.quantity*i.unit_price_cents-i.discount_cents-COALESCE(r.refund_cents,0) AS net_revenue_cents,
  r.return_ids, r.refund_dates, r.return_reasons
FROM ranked x JOIN orders o USING(order_id) JOIN order_items i USING(order_id)

rules: 金额加总仅对已支付订单；取消订单有报价明细，无履约和退货，不计销售和成本。
净销售额=原价总额-折扣-退款；净商品成本=售出商品成本-可再次销售商品收回成本。
投放前经营贡献=净销售额-净商品成本-佣金-退货处理成本-正向物流；投放后再扣广告；均未扣租金、人工、税费、总部费用，不等于净利润。
经营视图以原下单日归属已知退款，历史月份会被后续退款修正；现金退款日分析直接使用 returns.return_date。本样例不是现金流量表。
退货、明细、订单、投放、目标为不同粒度事实，必须各自聚合到公共粒度后连接。不得把日广告或月目标直接连接订单明细后 SUM。
订单物流成本没有 SKU 分摊、广告没有订单/客户/SKU 归因；不提供商品投放后利润、CAC 或广告增量回报。
比率使用总分子/总分母，不平均行级比率；零分母返回 NULL，不能强填 0。
最近 30 天订单退货观察不完整；退货诊断优先选择 order_date<=2026-10-01，观察期口径仍不等于终身退货率。
复购必须使用完整 60 天观察窗口；客户数和队列指标不能跨分组直接相加。
2026 年只有 1—10 月，同比需与 2025 年 1—10 月比较；禁止直接比较全年总额。
日期、活动、折扣、渠道变化存在共同发生因素；样例可演示关联诊断，不能据此证明因果。

steps.question: 真的下降了吗？是订单变少、折后支付下降，还是退款增加？
steps.required: 展示支付单数、折后支付销售额、退款、净销售额、广告支出、投放前后经营贡献；计算环比与绝对变化；用 Δ净销售额=Δ折后支付销售额-Δ退款精确对账

steps.question: 哪个渠道解释了下降？渠道是否已增加投放、是否亏损？
steps.required: 逐渠道列本期、上期、差额；渠道差额加总必须等于全站差额；负贡献渠道不得仅因销售额下降而建议加投

steps.question: 主要下降渠道内，问题集中在哪个大区、门店？
steps.required: 样例重点短视频 channel_id=4；先汇总大区再门店，对比净销售额、退款和投放后经营贡献；保留其他地区作为对照，门店合计必须与渠道一致

steps.question: 哪些品类、SKU 的退货和商品贡献发生变化？
steps.required: 大区→品类→子品类→SKU；展示售出件数、退货件数、件数退货率、退款金额率和商品贡献；按总分子/总分母计算比率，标明样本量；不能将日广告直接连到 SKU 或声称 SKU 投放后利润

steps.question: 退货原因、配送是否支持质量与履约异常的判断？
steps.required: 退款按原订单月对账，原因按质量/延迟/预期/无理由分开；准时率=到期且准时签收单数/已到期配送单数，逾期未签收计不准时；履约只按订单计数，禁止联明细后重复计数

steps.question: 能否落到原始订单和退款，并核实计算？
steps.required: 展示订单、商品明细、退货事件 ID 与计算公式；02_lineage 每门店渠道仅选一笔退款最多订单，标明是来源样本，不能作为全站归因证据

steps.question: 最终是否加大投放？
steps.required: 必须明确回答当前是扩大、维持还是暂缓预算，给出证据、优先事项与复评条件；按 decision_rules 作判断，不得停在泛泛的继续分析，也不得在新数据不满足规则时照搬样例结论。不能据历史相关性确定最优预算或宣称广告导致退款。

decision_rules: 若净销售额下降但折后支付和订单数增长，且退款增量超过支付增量，则下降直接来自退款侵蚀，不能把下降直接解释为缺流量。
若主要下降渠道广告已增加、投放后经营贡献转负且退款率明显上升，则当前不应以挽救销售为由继续扩大该链路预算；优先核查并修复质量、承诺时效和客群预期。
其他渠道历史贡献为正，不足以证明转移预算或加投有增量收益；没有实验与订单级广告归因时，不推荐确定的加投金额或增长承诺。
修复后按可比客群和区域小规模设对照，观察完整退货期后的增量投放后经营贡献；为正且履约、退货未恶化时，再讨论扩大预算。

queries.question: 2026 年 8 月净销售额下降了，要不要加大投放？
queries.query: 从 v_store_channel_day 视图中，按月汇总 2026年7月和8月的支付订单数、折后支付销售额(paid_sales_cents)、退款(refund_cents)、净销售额(net_revenue_cents)、广告支出(spend_cents)、投放前经营贡献(contribution_before_ads_cents)、投放后经营贡献(contribution_after_ads_cents)，所有金额转为元。计算8月相对7月的环比变化量，以及净销售额变化=折后支付变化-退款变化来对账。
queries.sql:
WITH monthly AS (
  SELECT 
    substr(spend_date, 1, 7) AS month,
    SUM(paid_orders) AS paid_orders,
    SUM(paid_sales_cents) / 100.0 AS paid_sales,
    SUM(refund_cents) / 100.0 AS refund,
    SUM(net_revenue_cents) / 100.0 AS net_revenue,
    SUM(spend_cents) / 100.0 AS advertising,
    SUM(contribution_before_ads_cents) / 100.0 AS contribution_before_ads,
    SUM(contribution_after_ads_cents) / 100.0 AS contribution_after_ads
  FROM v_store_channel_day
  WHERE spend_date BETWEEN '2026-07-01' AND '2026-08-31'
  GROUP BY substr(spend_date, 1, 7)
),
july AS (
  SELECT * FROM monthly WHERE month = '2026-07'
),
august AS (
  SELECT * FROM monthly WHERE month = '2026-08'
)
SELECT 
  j.paid_orders AS july_paid_orders,
  a.paid_orders AS august_paid_orders,
  a.paid_orders - j.paid_orders AS delta_paid_orders,
  j.paid_sales AS july_paid_sales,
  a.paid_sales AS august_paid_sales,
  a.paid_sales - j.paid_sales AS delta_paid_sales,
  j.refund AS july_refund,
  a.refund AS august_refund,
  a.refund - j.refund AS delta_refund,
  j.net_revenue AS july_net_revenue,
  a.net_revenue AS august_net_revenue,
  a.net_revenue - j.net_revenue AS delta_net_revenue,
  j.advertising AS july_advertising,
  a.advertising AS august_advertising,
  a.advertising - j.advertising AS delta_advertising,
  j.contribution_before_ads AS july_contribution_before_ads,
  a.contribution_before_ads AS august_contribution_before_ads,
  a.contribution_before_ads - j.contribution_before_ads AS delta_contribution_before_ads,
  j.contribution_after_ads AS july_contribution_after_ads,
  a.contribution_after_ads AS august_contribution_after_ads,
  a.contribution_after_ads - j.contribution_after_ads AS delta_contribution_after_ads,
  (a.paid_sales - j.paid_sales) - (a.refund - j.refund) AS reconcile_delta_net_revenue
FROM july j
CROSS JOIN august a;

queries.query: 从 v_store_channel_day 与 channels，按月(substr(spend_date,1,7))和渠道名(channel_name)分组，汇总7月和8月的 paid_orders, paid_sales_cents/100, refund_cents/100, net_revenue_cents/100, spend_cents/100, contribution_after_ads_cents/100。过滤 spend_date 在 2026-07-01 到 2026-08-31。计算每个渠道8月减7月的差值。
queries.sql:
WITH monthly AS (
  SELECT substr(d.spend_date, 1, 7) AS month, c.channel_name,
    SUM(d.paid_orders) AS paid_orders,
    SUM(d.paid_sales_cents) / 100.0 AS paid_sales,
    SUM(d.refund_cents) / 100.0 AS refunds,
    SUM(d.net_revenue_cents) / 100.0 AS net_revenue,
    SUM(d.spend_cents) / 100.0 AS advertising,
    SUM(d.contribution_after_ads_cents) / 100.0 AS contribution_after_ads
  FROM v_store_channel_day d
  JOIN channels c ON d.channel_id = c.channel_id
  WHERE d.spend_date BETWEEN '2026-07-01' AND '2026-08-31'
  GROUP BY substr(d.spend_date, 1, 7), c.channel_name
)
SELECT channel_name,
  SUM(CASE WHEN month = '2026-07' THEN paid_orders END) AS jul_paid_orders,
  SUM(CASE WHEN month = '2026-08' THEN paid_orders END) AS aug_paid_orders,
  SUM(CASE WHEN month = '2026-08' THEN paid_orders END)
    - SUM(CASE WHEN month = '2026-07' THEN paid_orders END) AS diff_paid_orders,
  SUM(CASE WHEN month = '2026-07' THEN paid_sales END) AS jul_paid_sales,
  SUM(CASE WHEN month = '2026-08' THEN paid_sales END) AS aug_paid_sales,
  SUM(CASE WHEN month = '2026-08' THEN paid_sales END)
    - SUM(CASE WHEN month = '2026-07' THEN paid_sales END) AS diff_paid_sales,
  SUM(CASE WHEN month = '2026-07' THEN refunds END) AS jul_refunds,
  SUM(CASE WHEN month = '2026-08' THEN refunds END) AS aug_refunds,
  SUM(CASE WHEN month = '2026-08' THEN refunds END)
    - SUM(CASE WHEN month = '2026-07' THEN refunds END) AS diff_refunds,
  SUM(CASE WHEN month = '2026-07' THEN net_revenue END) AS jul_net_revenue,
  SUM(CASE WHEN month = '2026-08' THEN net_revenue END) AS aug_net_revenue,
  SUM(CASE WHEN month = '2026-08' THEN net_revenue END)
    - SUM(CASE WHEN month = '2026-07' THEN net_revenue END) AS diff_net_revenue,
  SUM(CASE WHEN month = '2026-07' THEN advertising END) AS jul_advertising,
  SUM(CASE WHEN month = '2026-08' THEN advertising END) AS aug_advertising,
  SUM(CASE WHEN month = '2026-08' THEN advertising END)
    - SUM(CASE WHEN month = '2026-07' THEN advertising END) AS diff_advertising,
  SUM(CASE WHEN month = '2026-07' THEN contribution_after_ads END) AS jul_contribution_after_ads,
  SUM(CASE WHEN month = '2026-08' THEN contribution_after_ads END) AS aug_contribution_after_ads,
  SUM(CASE WHEN month = '2026-08' THEN contribution_after_ads END)
    - SUM(CASE WHEN month = '2026-07' THEN contribution_after_ads END) AS diff_contribution_after_ads
FROM monthly
GROUP BY channel_name
ORDER BY channel_name;

queries.question: 2026 年 8 月净销售额下降了，要不要加大投放？
queries.query: 从 v_store_channel_day 关联 stores 表，筛选 channel_id=4（短视频商城），在2026-07-01至2026-08-31区间，按月份(substr(spend_date,1,7))和大区(region)汇总 paid_orders, paid_sales_cents/100, refund_cents/100, net_revenue_cents/100, spend_cents/100, contribution_after_ads_cents/100。计算每个大区8月减7月的差值，按净销售额差值从大到小排序。
queries.sql:
WITH monthly_region AS (
  SELECT 
    s.region,
    substr(d.spend_date, 1, 7) AS month,
    SUM(d.paid_orders) AS paid_orders,
    SUM(d.paid_sales_cents) / 100.0 AS paid_sales,
    SUM(d.refund_cents) / 100.0 AS refunds,
    SUM(d.net_revenue_cents) / 100.0 AS net_revenue,
    SUM(d.spend_cents) / 100.0 AS spend,
    SUM(d.contribution_after_ads_cents) / 100.0 AS contribution_after_ads
  FROM v_store_channel_day d
  JOIN stores s ON d.store_id = s.store_id
  WHERE d.channel_id = 4 
    AND d.spend_date BETWEEN '2026-07-01' AND '2026-08-31'
  GROUP BY s.region, month
)
SELECT 
  region,
  SUM(CASE WHEN month = '2026-08' THEN paid_orders ELSE 0 END) - 
  SUM(CASE WHEN month = '2026-07' THEN paid_orders ELSE 0 END) AS diff_paid_orders,
  SUM(CASE WHEN month = '2026-08' THEN paid_sales ELSE 0 END) - 
  SUM(CASE WHEN month = '2026-07' THEN paid_sales ELSE 0 END) AS diff_paid_sales,
  SUM(CASE WHEN month = '2026-08' THEN refunds ELSE 0 END) - 
  SUM(CASE WHEN month = '2026-07' THEN refunds ELSE 0 END) AS diff_refunds,
  SUM(CASE WHEN month = '2026-08' THEN net_revenue ELSE 0 END) - 
  SUM(CASE WHEN month = '2026-07' THEN net_revenue ELSE 0 END) AS diff_net_revenue,
  SUM(CASE WHEN month = '2026-08' THEN spend ELSE 0 END) - 
  SUM(CASE WHEN month = '2026-07' THEN spend ELSE 0 END) AS diff_spend,
  SUM(CASE WHEN month = '2026-08' THEN contribution_after_ads ELSE 0 END) - 
  SUM(CASE WHEN month = '2026-07' THEN contribution_after_ads ELSE 0 END) AS diff_contribution_after_ads
FROM monthly_region
GROUP BY region
ORDER BY diff_net_revenue DESC;

WITH monthly_stats AS (

queries.sql:
WITH ranked AS (
  SELECT order_id,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(refund_cents) DESC, order_id) AS rn
  FROM v_item_economics
  WHERE store_id = 1 AND channel_id = 4
    AND order_date BETWEEN '2026-08-01' AND '2026-08-31'
  GROUP BY order_id
),
top_order AS (
  SELECT order_id FROM ranked WHERE rn = 1
),
item_details AS (
  SELECT i.order_item_id, i.product_id, i.quantity, i.unit_price_cents, i.discount_cents,
    i.quantity * i.unit_price_cents AS gross_sales_cents,
    i.quantity * i.unit_price_cents - i.discount_cents AS paid_sales_cents,
    i.refund_cents,
    i.quantity * i.unit_price_cents - i.discount_cents - i.refund_cents AS net_revenue_cents,
    i.net_cogs_cents, i.commission_cents, i.handling_cost_cents, i.item_contribution_cents
  FROM v_item_economics i
  WHERE i.order_id IN (SELECT order_id FROM top_order)
),
item_summary AS (
  SELECT 'item_detail' AS source, order_item_id AS line_id, product_id, quantity,
    unit_price_cents, discount_cents, gross_sales_cents, paid_sales_cents,
    refund_cents, net_revenue_cents, net_cogs_cents, commission_cents,
    handling_cost_cents, NULL AS shipping_cost_cents, item_contribution_cents
  FROM item_details

  UNION ALL

  SELECT 'item_sum' AS source, NULL, NULL, SUM(quantity), NULL,
    SUM(discount_cents), SUM(gross_sales_cents), SUM(paid_sales_cents),
    SUM(refund_cents), SUM(net_revenue_cents), SUM(net_cogs_cents),
    SUM(commission_cents), SUM(handling_cost_cents), NULL,
    SUM(item_contribution_cents)
  FROM item_details

  UNION ALL

  SELECT 'order_view' AS source, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL,
    o.discount_cents, o.gross_sales_cents, o.paid_sales_cents,
    o.refund_cents, o.net_revenue_cents, o.net_cogs_cents,
    o.commission_cents, o.handling_cost_cents, o.shipping_cost_cents,
    o.contribution_before_ads_cents
  FROM v_order_economics o
  WHERE o.order_id IN (SELECT order_id FROM top_order)
)
